description: A page of Arc USDC address-poisoning events from the live index: block, tx, kind, victim, poisoner, the address it mimics, and the USDC amount. $0.01 per page, up to 50 rows. Pass afterBlock and afterTx from the previous page together or the boundary block can repeat. Counts in the page come from the live index. The free counts tool is arc_poison_stats. This is not a permission to pay.

after.description: block cursor, if afterBlock is omitted

afterBlock.description: block cursor. after is the same field.

afterTx.description: 0x and 64 hex. Pass it with the block.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (base64, as in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it here and the purchase completes inside this tool call.
